name: Can I replace my traditional tank water heater with a tankless model?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my traditional tank water heater with a tankless model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can upgrade from a traditional tank water heater to a tankless model. This conversion often involves rerouting plumbing, upgrading gas lines to a larger size for gas units, or increasing electrical capacity for electric units. Proper venting also needs to be established for gas models. A professional assessment is essential to determine the specific requirements and feasibility for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it often requires plumbing, gas line, or electrical upgrades, and proper venting. A professional assessment is essential.
